q: Why should text-to-SQL use a semantic layer?
options: It fixes business definitions such as “active customer” so the model does not invent them
It removes the need for a schema
explain: Agreed definitions make answers consistent and correct.

q: What is the safest way to run model-generated SQL?
options: On the primary database with an admin role
On a read-only replica with a restricted role, SELECT only, a row limit and a timeout
explain: Contain the blast radius of any bad query.

q: Which method finds exact function names and error strings in code best?
options: Lexical search such as grep, ideally driven by an agent
